'''Ben Coonce''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Merritt Island Grand Slam]] on 4 March 2000 with [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations]], according to Leonard Mitchell's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d325">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-08-merritt-island-florida-03-04-00d325/ merritt-island-florida-03-04-00], DeckTech (Leonard "Master Yoda" Mitchell, 8 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-08-merritt-island-florida-03-04-00d325/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
